## Gate.tsx

Source: [src/components/persona/Gate.tsx](../../../src/components/persona/Gate.tsx)

### `Gate`

*component* · [src/components/persona/Gate.tsx:14](../../../src/components/persona/Gate.tsx#L14)

```ts
Gate({ cap, perm, occasion, when, fallback = null, children }: { cap?: Capability; perm?: Permission; occasion?: OccasionId; when?: When; fallback?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode })
```

Renders its children only when the signed-in persona passes the rule.
`cap`, `perm` and `occasion` are shorthands for the common single checks.

  <Gate cap="space.halls">…</Gate>
  <Gate perm="payout.release" fallback={<ReadOnlyNote />}>…</Gate>

### `staffScreen`

*function* · [src/components/persona/StaffGate.tsx:30](../../../src/components/persona/StaffGate.tsx#L30)

```ts
staffScreen<P extends object>(route: string, Screen: ComponentType<P>)
```

Wraps an operations screen so it only opens for staff whose permissions
pass its rule in `PLATFORM_ROUTE_RULES`; others get `NoAccess`. The store
actions behind the screen check permissions again.
